en:
I was finally able to turn around, and
nobody came to help. Kamurocho is such
a disappointment. Nobody cares here.

Well, please keep my underwear in your
prayers. The dark price was too steep, and
it left this world in about as cruel a way as
any pair of undies could go... I'm so sorry.

A small fire broke out. I saw a firetruck
heading in that direction. I knew I should've
called the police sooner.

Maybe I was just imagining things... But this
is gonna keep me up at night, I just know it.

Apparently that little boy was just really
hungry. He fainted and got hauled away
in an ambulance.

The drunk guy never did budge. He reeked,
and he kept muttering stuff to people...
Sometimes Kamurocho feels like a real
dump.

I guess the police eventually found that kid,
and the poor little guy was so exhausted
he could barely even cry anymore. I'm
tearing up here.

The person couldn't hang on anymore and
fell. Apparently they didn't end up with
severe injuries, but I bet it hurt.

The person fell to the ground. Luckily, they
weren't severely injured, but I can't believe
no one even tried to help...

They found some guy beaten half to death
near Theater Square. Word is they might
not make it... There's no justice in this town
anymore...

Some people ended up getting hurt...
I heard they were just left to bleed out
on the street, too... Shameful.

Just when I thought they were getting too
scared, they're back to their old tricks and
bragging about making easy money on the
streets. I wish somebody'd stand up to
them.

I just saw those thugs walk out of a
store with a whole bunch of expensive
electronics. Guess they got the money
from that dude after all...

Just saw a guy walk out of Pink Alley looking
tattered and broken. I guess the Champion
of Justice was too busy.

Man, I guess I was naive to expect a
champion of justice to fix everything.
That middle-aged man was crying into
his hands on the curb.

Turns out no one wanted to help that poor
girl... I sure hope she's okay...

No one came to help... People like them
give Kamurocho the reputation it deserves.

Of course people just turn a blind eye to
this kind of thing. Have been for years. I'm
angry that I'm not strong enough to stop it
myself, but I'm even angrier that the people
who are strong enough chose to do nothing!

An ambulance just showed up on the scene.
I just hope they pull through...

I heard the victim is in critical condition.
They probably won't even be able to live
a normal life after this... I think about how
this could have been avoided if someone
had helped them, and it makes me so sad...

The victim's supposedly in pretty bad shape.
The reporters couldn't even say how badly
they were hurt... I wonder if someone could
have stopped this...

No one came to help them. I wonder if
they're okay? Makes me sick to my
stomach...

Looks like we ended up with two more
victims. This is disgusting.

Looks like another couple is on the way to
the ER. When will this nightmare end?

It seems that pickpocket is really cleaning
up out there... Onomichi's reputation is as
good as ruined.

Sounds like a whole bunch of graves got dug
up and a ton of valuables went missing. It's
disgusting, in so many ways.

I couldn't get the delivery out... The phone
at the restaurant won't stop ringing, either.
Sorry to be a wet noodle, but I think I'm
gonna skip town...

I think that fire must have burned out on
its own. We sure got lucky this time...

The building burned down... Luckily, the fire
went out with it. Hard to believe nobody
tried to put it out, but... What can you
expect from Kamurocho?

The smoke's gone, but... I think all it
did was burn itself out. There's probably
some pretty bad damage...

I guess sometimes fate takes what's
important to you. But still, what a disaster.
Isn't there any way this could have been
avoided?

It looks like he signed off, so that must
mean he left the café. He got away this
time, but let's hope there's another chance!

You disappoint me. You masquerade as
justice incarnate, but fall short of the mark
when it really counts. Pathetic.

I guess you couldn't get there in time.
Still no idea who the arsonist is,
either. I bet the fires won't stop here.

Looks like the fire burnt out on its own, but
we really got lucky this time. I guess nobody
had time to check it out.

It must have been the same arsonist, but
since no one came, I guess we'll never know
for sure. At least the fire's out... Not like all
you cold-blooded reptiles care.

No one went to look. The fire didn't spread,
but I'll never forget the day you all turned
your back on this city...

I can't believe another fire broke out in
Kamurocho. Good thing the fire trucks
made it before it got out of hand...

Here's the bomb! HaHaHa!
Do you know this city well enough to figure
out where it is?

Aww, are you struggling to find it in
a city you claim to know? Here's the hint I
snapped in case you turned out to be an idiot.

Still lost? I knew you were stupid, but man,
what a moron! Here's the final hint before
the KaBOOM!

I got the order from Lullaby Mahjong!
Please, run like the round wind!

Kiryu-san, if the serial bomber's patterns
are anything to go on, he'll be leaving the
café in about five minutes. If you're going
to get him, now would be the time!

Kiryu-san, we're down to about two
minutes before the serial bomber leaves
the café! Can you get to him in time!?

I saw someone keeled over in pain on
East National Route 2, near the pedestrian
bridge! I can't stop, so I'm hoping someone
here on Troublr can!

I just looked out the window of my car
and I think I saw someone in serious pain
just south of the Theater! I can't stop
there myself, so can someone help!?

*Urgent: PLEASE SHARE!*
I'm inside the Children's Park bathroom and
it's OUT OF TOILET PAPER! Can you make it
snappy? I have an important meeting soon!

There's been an alarming increase in
arsons here in Onomichi lately, and I
just saw a suspicious guy near the port.
He was clearly trying to keep a low
profile, so I didn't want to approach!

I was minding my own business at the
Oyster Shack on Shishido Street, when my
eye caught some shady business. I'm not
sure what I saw, but I just want to be sure...
Can anyone check it out? I'm too scared.

I saw a little boy squatting in the middle
of the shopping center. Maybe he wasn't
feeling well? I hope he's all right... I didn't
check, but now I'm kicking myself! Can
someone look in on him?

There's this drunk in Public Park Three, and
he's being a nuisance. He's making me and
some other people pretty uncomfortable...
I wish someone would put a stop to him...

There was this woman looking pretty
frantic at the shrine. Apparently she and her
child got separated. I don't know the area
too well... Can anyone swing by?

I saw someone dangling from the ceiling
of the Central Shopping District. It'll
only be a matter of time until the person
falls. Someone help them!

There's someone hanging on for dear life
from the rooftop of the batting center!
I don't want to imagine what'll happen
if they fall! Someone help!

I've heard there's a bunch of guys shaking
people down for cash in Theater Alley...
Seems like there's a new victim every
day, too. I wish someone would take care
of those punks...

I heard those shakedown guys showed
up northwest of Theater Square.
If you're still out there... can you do
something about them again?

I saw someone get pulled into a manhole
near the Hotel District! They're supposedly
taking victims underground so no one can
see them shake people down. Please,
someone save them!

I saw a rough-looking crowd harassing a
middle-aged guy near the Millennium
Tower. I bet these are those dad hunters
I've heard so much about.

I heard another middle-aged man was
getting harassed in Pink Alley. Why are
people still doing this? If you're still out
there, Gray-suited Champion of Justice,
we need you!

Those dad-hunter guys are back again on
East Taihei Boulevard. It's in your hands,
Champion of Justice!

I saw these gross guys harassing a girl
in front of the Millennium Tower.
I've heard rumors about the terrible
things these assholes do to those poor
women...

Those perverts don't know when to quit.
They're in front of Theater Square now!
Someone needs to put these scumbags in
their place...

Those guys committing sexual assault
seem to have moved their operation into
the Millennium Tower. I can't believe they
think they can get away with messing with
girls just because they're inside. Someone
should wreck them for good!

I saw someone being attacked by a mob
in the Hotel District. If nobody comes
soon, they could be killed...

There's another mob getting aggressive
on some defenseless person in Theater
Square. I don't know why they keep doing
this, but they need to be stopped before
someone gets killed.

A mob is forming in Nakamichi Alley.
I heard it's getting pretty bad. Can't anyone
help!?

There's a group of thugs that hangs out in
Nakamichi Alley to harass passing couples.
Apparently they take some kind of sick
pleasure in making people in love suffer.
How screwed up is that?

I heard those jerks are still messing with
couples. I saw them leering at people
around the Millennium Tower. I kinda
wish they'd just drop dead.

Those couple hunters have resurfaced.
This time, they're dragging couples into
an empty room in the Senryo Building.
Someone has to help them!

I heard there's a pickpocket who's been
hanging around Hana-no-kubo. That's
where all the tourists hang out, so this
is going to escalate quickly...

I've heard a creepy rumor that some grave
robbers have been sighted in the cemetery.
Geez, talk about feudal-era crimes, right?
I'd check, but... hell no, man. Hell no.

My chronic back pain has the worst timing!
It flared up during my ramen delivery! This
customer will raise hell if his ramen is late
or his noodles are soggy too! Let's just say...
Udon wanna mess with him!

I'm by Kyushu No. 1 Star if you can help!

I can see smoke coming from a rooftop
in Nakamichi Alley. Something's gotta be
on fire. If it doesn't get put out soon, it'll
tear through the streets!

There's smoke coming from a building on
Senryo Avenue! It's gotta be another fire.
Is anyone close enough to put it out!?

I can see smoke billowing from the roof
of the batting cages. It better not be
another big fire...

FIRE: Jingai Main Street! A CAR IS ON FIRE!!!
The owner is screaming about how
something important is trapped in the car!
But the car will never last until the fire truck
can get here!

Kiryu-san,
It's me, Torafuru. This is a DM, so only you
can see it. I traced that serial bomber's IP,
and it seems like he's posting to Troublr
from an internet café. Maybe you could
catch him if you dropped in at the right
café!

The clock is ticking in Kamurocho...
I've set up a bomb, and my challenge to you
is this: Can you find it in the ten minutes
before it blows?

I see a lot of smoke coming from a
building on Tenkaichi Street! Is this
another arson attempt!? What if it
spreads!?

There's smoke coming from an alley on
Cemetery Lane. Think it's the arsonist who's
been starting all those fires? Someone
should check it out.

There's smoke coming from the Navy
Apartments. That stupid arsonist strikes
again! Can someone get down there!?

I see smoke coming from a house in
Hana-no-kubo! I think it's coming from the
balcony, or somewhere above ground,
anyway. The houses out there are all made
of wood, so someone needs to get up there
fast!

Ever since that fire in Little Asia,
there's been an increase in arsons across
Kamurocho. I saw this shady guy on the
east side of Taihei Boulevard and I can't
help but think it's related. Pretty creepy!

Ugh, I'm so booored.
I <font_kind=yakuza_italic>am</font_kind> feeling kind of horny, though.
Anyone up for a little romp between the
sheets? Try and find me if you're game.
I'll be waiting! <symbol=note_with_outline>

Ughhh, why's nobody talking to me!?
Maybe I'll just handle things myself at home.
<font_kind=yakuza_italic>Unlesssss</font_kind> somebody wants to come lend
a hand... Or maybe more. <symbol=note_with_outline>

Awww, nobody came to say hello.
I moved somewhere new, though... <symbol=note_with_outline>
Can anyone guess where I am?
